evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label; modifies HTTP RPC error handling in src/httprpc.cpp and adds protocol error codes in src/rpc/protocol.h.
rationale: The PR fixes an RPC protocol compliance bug where whitelist rejections returned an empty HTTP 403 body instead of structured JSON-RPC errors. This violates documented JSON-RPC 2.0 behavior and breaks clients like bitcoin-cli with JSON decoding errors.
